# `mise history`

- **Usage:** `mise history [FLAGS] [SUBCOMMAND]`
- **Effect:** read-only
- **Source code:** [`src/cli/history/mod.rs`](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/main/src/cli/history/mod.rs)

Browse and save checkpoints of your configuration files

Every mutating bootstrap command and every `mise history save` records a
checkpoint of the tracked files: the global mise config directory, the
dotfiles root, and every `[dotfiles]` entry. Without a subcommand this
lists them, newest first.

## Flags
- **`-J --json`** — Output in JSON format
- **`-n --limit <LIMIT>`** — Show at most this many checkpoints (0 for all)

  **Default:** `20`
- **`--path <PATH>`** — Only checkpoints where this path (or something under it) changed
- **`--trigger <TRIGGER>`** — Only checkpoints with this trigger (edit, save, bootstrap, …)
- **`--pending`** — Only checkpoints recorded by operations that did not finish
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Subcommands

- [`mise history describe <REF> <TEXT>`](/cli/history/describe.md)
- [`mise history diff [FLAGS] [A] [B]`](/cli/history/diff.md)
- [`mise history ls [FLAGS]`](/cli/history/ls.md)
- [`mise history paths`](/cli/history/paths.md)
- [`mise history save [FLAGS] [PATH]…`](/cli/history/save.md)
- [`mise history show [FLAGS] [REF]`](/cli/history/show.md)
- [`mise history status [-J --json]`](/cli/history/status.md)

Examples:

```
mise history
mise history --path ~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua
mise history show latest
mise history diff                    # the working tree against the latest checkpoint
mise history diff 11 12 --patch
mise history save --description "before the theme change"
```
